DISCOVERY TO IMPACT

A causal language for the brain

Observation can show correlation. Optogenetic perturbation lets researchers ask whether a defined circuit element is necessary or sufficient for a behavior—with millisecond-scale control.

01DISCOVER

Microbial photoreceptors

Light-gated proteins convert photons into ion flow across a membrane.

02ENGINEER

Target selected cells

Genetic targeting places an opsin in a chosen neural population.

03PERTURB

Deliver timed light

Light activates or inhibits those cells with high temporal precision.

04INFER

Test causal function

Measure circuit, physiological, or behavioral change to test a hypothesis.

N

THE AWARD

2026 Nobel Prize

Deisseroth shared the prize with Peter Hegemann and Georg Nagel for discoveries concerning light-gated ion channels and optogenetics—linking foundational microbial protein research to a transformative neuroscience method.
